facts.fact: Plan agreed in ch 1: Neela spends the first of her two remaining resin smears on the night of ch 1 to run the wood road ahead as the other one; the second is kept for inside the Resin House. They take the wood road by the lower ford, half a day longer, because the ridge track is walked by the pass-village watcher.
Ittan's tally-book margin shorthand is copied from Resin House receipts, so Neela can read the counts and payments but not the masters' name marks.
